## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A phase interrupted after N of M checkpointed steps resumes and performs...

The system SHALL ensure that a phase interrupted after N of M checkpointed steps resumes and performs only steps N+1..M, verified with a recording runner.

#### Scenario: A phase interrupted after N of M checkpointed steps resumes and performs...

WHEN `add-phase-progress-checkpoints-and-resume-in-phase-agent` is implemented
THEN A phase interrupted after N of M checkpointed steps resumes and performs only steps N+1..M, verified with a recording runner.

### Requirement: For a step with a missing checkpoint but a started or completed effect,...

The system SHALL ensure that for a step with a missing checkpoint but a started or completed effect, resume consults the effects journal and does not repeat the effect.

#### Scenario: For a step with a missing checkpoint but a started or completed effect,...

WHEN `add-phase-progress-checkpoints-and-resume-in-phase-agent` is implemented
THEN For a step with a missing checkpoint but a started or completed effect, resume consults the effects journal and does not repeat the effect.

### Requirement: Retry budget counts attempts without progress; an attempt adding at least...

The system SHALL ensure that retry budget counts attempts without progress; an attempt adding at least one checkpoint does not consume budget, and a hard ceiling stops unbounded loops.

#### Scenario: Retry budget counts attempts without progress; an attempt adding at least...

WHEN `add-phase-progress-checkpoints-and-resume-in-phase-agent` is implemented
THEN Retry budget counts attempts without progress; an attempt adding at least one checkpoint does not consume budget, and a hard ceiling stops unbounded loops.

### Requirement: The finalized PhaseRecord of a resumed phase has the same shape as a...

The system SHALL ensure that the finalized PhaseRecord of a resumed phase has the same shape as a single-attempt PhaseRecord and passes session-log validation; the (outcome, handoff_id) driver contract is unchanged.

#### Scenario: The finalized PhaseRecord of a resumed phase has the same shape as a...

WHEN `add-phase-progress-checkpoints-and-resume-in-phase-agent` is implemented
THEN The finalized PhaseRecord of a resumed phase has the same shape as a single-attempt PhaseRecord and passes session-log validation; the (outcome, handoff_id) driver contract is unchanged.

### Requirement: Missing or corrupt progress journals fall back to retry-from-scratch with a...

The system SHALL ensure that missing or corrupt progress journals fall back to retry-from-scratch with a reported warning, and loop-state.json remains the sole authority for the current phase.

#### Scenario: Missing or corrupt progress journals fall back to retry-from-scratch with a...

WHEN `add-phase-progress-checkpoints-and-resume-in-phase-agent` is implemented
THEN Missing or corrupt progress journals fall back to retry-from-scratch with a reported warning, and loop-state.json remains the sole authority for the current phase.
